cohort: Infants diagnosed with PAIS (cases) and comparison infants (controls)
finding: Male sex, multiple birth, chorioamnionitis, preterm birth, and small for gestational age (SGA) were independent risk factors for perinatal arterial ischemic stroke (PAIS).
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of PAIS in univariate analysis, but not in the final adjusted model.
